description: Precedence test: when both `trailingSlash` and `redirects` could fire on the same source path, which wins? Reference's `shouldRedirect` orders trailingSlash (lines 145-168) BEFORE the redirects loop (lines 172-182), so the trailingSlash 301 fires first and the configured redirect is never reached. Closes one corner of SRV-ROUT-006 left open at the end of Stage 6c.
